DataFindR: LLM-assisted screening and data extraction for metawoRld projects

Source: R/DataFindR-package.R
DataFindR-package.Rd

Typical workflow:

  1. df_search_pubmed() (or df_fetch_metadata() / df_add_metadata()) collects records and caches their titles and abstracts.

  2. df_assess_batch() screens them against the project's criteria; df_shiny_assess() lets you review and override decisions.

  3. df_extract_batch() extracts data from the full texts of included studies; df_shiny_extract() lets you check and correct the results.

  4. df_import_batch() validates and stores the studies in the metawoRld project. df_status() and df_prisma_counts() show progress.

Details

Prompts, schemas and criteria live in the metawoRld project and can be edited there. All LLM results are cached in the project with their provenance, so repeated runs only process new or changed work.
